chunks: Yet they say: 'When will this decree come, if you speak the truth?'

key_terms.الْفَتْحُ: The victory, opening, or decisive event

ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers ask Prophet Muhammad regarding the timing of the divine promise?
ai.summary: In Surah As-Sajdah (32:3), the disbelievers of Mecca challenge the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to hasten the 'Fath' (victory or opening), reflecting their impatience for divine retribution or the establishment of Islamic rule. Shia exegetes often interpret this 'Fath' not only as the initial conquest of Mecca but also as a broader eschatological promise, linking it to the ultimate triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt and the reappearance of the Imam of the Age. This verse underscores the theme of divine timing versus human impatience, a key concept in Shia theology regarding the Occultation and the eventual global justice.
